product_metadata.title: Intelligent Design Nadia 100% Cotton Luxurious Bath Towel Set, Jacquard Chveron Design Highly Absorbent, Quick Dry, Hotel & Spa Quality for Bathroom, Multi-Sizes, Multi-Sizes, Seafoam 6 Piece
features: PRODUCT FEATURES - Soft, highly water absorbant and durable featuring cotton jacquard woven, superior and lightweight fabric.
MATERIALS - Towel sets for bathroom with premium cotton; simply remove and dissipate moisture from your skin, feel light and comfortable to hold
Hotel Like Quality - 100% cotton and 550gsm weight, soft and plush while highly absorbent.
Set includes: 2 Bath Towels: 28"W x 54"L, 4 Hand Towels: 16"W x 26"L
Care Instruction: For your convenience it's machine washable.Do not use bleach.Commercial size washer and dryer is recommended for best result.
description: These 2-ply ring spun towels are cotton jacquard woven making them reversible in contrasting colors as well as incredibly absorbent. Each towel features a bold teal geometric print with a small grey dobby border. Set includes two bath towels and four hand towels.
